tools.name: scan_token
tools.description: Read a Robinhood Chain token right now: name, supply, owner powers, Pons v2 launch and graduation, creator tax, price, market cap, liquidity, 24h volume, buys and sells, deployer share and burned share. Every key carries its unit. Use it whenever the user mentions a token contract address.

tools.name: trace_wallet
tools.description: Read the wallet behind a Robinhood Chain token: how many tokens it launched through the Pons v2 factory in the last hours, how many graduated, how many are still on a curve, and whether it bought or sold on its own curves. Use it when the user asks who is behind a token, or about a deployer.

tools.name: robinhood_radar
tools.description: List Robinhood Chain tokens right now: `new` gives the latest Pons v2 launches (age, curve progress, market cap), `trending` gives the most traded tokens over 24h (volume, liquidity, buys and sells, change). Use it to find tokens, then scan_token to read one in depth.
